description: Executions whose expiry time is exactly equal to either the start or the end bound of the window are included in the per-order groups.

b.request: Filter order executions where `expirespot` is inclusively between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' (text-based comparison), group by `ordersmark`, calculate for each order the average of all non-null `remaincount` values and the total number of executions, then output one row containing the average of the per-order averages (excluding orders with no non-null `remaincount` values) and the sum of all per-order execution counts, with full precision.
b.sql:
WITH filtered_execs AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' 
    AND expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
),
per_order_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as order_avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) as order_exec_count
  FROM filtered_execs
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT 
  AVG(order_avg_remaincount) as avg_of_averages,
  SUM(order_exec_count) as total_exec_count
FROM per_order_stats
WHERE order_avg_remaincount IS NOT NULL

a.request: Looking only at order executions whose expiry time (`expirespot`) falls between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', with both endpoints included (comparing the values as text), group them by order (`ordersmark`) and, for each order, compute the average unfilled quantity (`remaincount`, ignoring missing values) and the number of executions. Then give me one row with the average of those per-order averages (ignoring missing ones) and the total of the per-order execution counts, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH per_order_stats AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_avg_remaincount, SUM(exec_count) as total_exec_count FROM per_order_stats
